title: Aislamiento tenant — auditoría y preflight

dependencies.purpose: UsuarioEmpresa membership and per-company roles baseline

authoritativeFindings: UsuarioEmpresa already models active membership and a per-company RolId; no duplicate membership model is permitted.
Usuario.RolId remains a legacy compatibility path and cannot be treated as tenant-aware authorization authority.
The current authorization path does not yet prove that effective permissions are resolved from the active UsuarioEmpresa membership.
The application still needs an authoritative current-company context that is validated against active membership instead of trusting a stale client claim.
Repositories and application queries need mandatory company scoping, and endpoints accepting entity IDs must reject cross-company identifiers fail-closed.
Membership deactivation or role change must invalidate cached/claimed effective authorization.
Negative regression coverage must prove no read, write, export, count or metadata leakage between two companies.
acceptanceCriteria: Current company is resolved server-side from authenticated user plus active UsuarioEmpresa membership; missing, inactive or ambiguous membership fails closed.
Effective role and permissions are derived from UsuarioEmpresa.RolId for the selected company; Usuario.RolId is not tenant authority.
Tenant-owned repositories and queries require an explicit verified EmpresaId scope and cannot silently fall back to global data.
Every application/API path that accepts a tenant-owned identifier rejects cross-tenant IDs without disclosing resource existence.
Membership deactivation and per-company role changes invalidate authorization context deterministically.
Automated negative tests use at least Empresa A and Empresa B and cover reads, mutations, list/count/export boundaries and stale-context cases.
No production execution, deployment, secret change, main write or PR #2 merge is part of N6.5.

orderedPlan.N6.5.B: Domain/contracts for verified current-company context and effective per-company role resolution; fail-closed invariants only.
orderedPlan.N6.5.C: Persistence/migration only if the accepted B contract requires durable state or constraints; otherwise evidence-backed N/A. Never invent a second membership relation.
orderedPlan.N6.5.D: Application/API propagation of verified company context, mandatory query scoping and cross-tenant identifier rejection.
orderedPlan.N6.5.E: Frontend current-company selection/context UX without granting authority to client state.
orderedPlan.N6.5.F: Tenant-aware RBAC, audit and cache/claim invalidation.
orderedPlan.N6.5.G: Two-company negative regression matrix and exact-head CI.

rollbackStrategy: N6.5.A is evidence-only and introduces no runtime or schema change.
Subsequent stages must preserve legacy data until tenant-aware authority is certified and must document reversible migration where applicable.
Any ambiguous or unverified tenant context remains denied rather than falling back to global access.

risks.risk: Using Usuario.RolId as current-company authority can grant permissions from the wrong tenant.
risks.mitigation: Resolve effective role from active UsuarioEmpresa membership.

risks.risk: Unscoped repository or identifier lookup can leak cross-tenant data or existence.
risks.mitigation: Mandatory verified EmpresaId scoping and fail-closed ID checks.

risks.risk: Stale claims/cache after membership change can preserve revoked access.

scopeBoundary.inScope: Directed audit, acceptance contract, dependency proof, risk/rollback definition and ordered N6.5 decomposition.
scopeBoundary.outOfScope: Large product implementation, schema mutation, deployment, production, secrets, main, PR #2 and Jules dispatch.

reviewCandidate.note: The preflight records P0/P1 risks as requirements; it does not claim those product risks are already remediated.

nextSafe: REVIEW_FIRST this evidence on exact head, then causal metadata gates; if accepted, certify N6.5.A and promote N6.5.B.
